Concept art for a tactical game. ONE creature, the SPITTER: the Rav Bloom swarm's fragile ranged strain (Starsector mod: Marines against an engineered biological weapon). This concept: TAIL-TRIPOD. Stands on two hind legs and plants its thick muscular tail as a third leg (a kangaroo-like tripod brace). A big translucent acid gland fills its belly and chest, below a heavily plated back. Short forelimbs. It FIRES FROM THE MOUTH: braced on the tripod, it rears its torso upright and heaves the glob up out of a long jaw.

SIDE VIEW concept of the same creature in reference image 2 (keep its design exactly), seen in profile facing RIGHT, caught at the instant it FIRES: braced, the acid organ visibly squeezing, a single glob of dark glowing green acid just leaving the firing opening on a high upward arc toward the upper right. The firing mechanism must be clear. Full body visible, centred, wide landscape canvas. Plain flat light grey background (#b4b4b4), no ground line, no shadow, no text, no border.
